title: fix: guard pending_approvals delete in reset-demo endpoint
body: ## Summary The `/api/invoices/[id]/reset-demo` endpoint crashes with a `DrizzleQueryError` when trying to delete from the `pending_approvals` table, which may not exist in the database if migrations haven't been run yet. This wraps the `pending_approvals` delete in a try/catch so the endpoint works regardless of whether the table exists. **Bug found during end-to-end testing of PR #13.** ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Hit `POST /api/invoices/inv-001/reset-demo` locally and confirm it returns `{"success":true,"invoiceId":"inv-001"}` instead of a 500 error - [ ] Verify the invoice status resets to "overdue" after the call ### Notes - The `pending_approvals` table is defined in `src/db/schema.ts` but may not have been pushed to the database yet via `drizzle-kit push` - Once the table is pushed, the try/catch becomes a no-op and the delete works normally Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/89b4bf9d924d4ce3b0b63a084ed15f58 Requested by: @botirk38 ---
